description: An opaque muted red court gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a long floor-length skirt. Narrow gold floral woven bands trim the neckline, central front, cuffs and hem. A dark belt with round metal ornaments crosses the waist. A red and ivory patterned wrap rests around the forearms. A small pendant necklace and brown leather shoes are visible.
